
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /login                                     │
  │  Provider Login                             │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Log in to a provider with an API key.

  Usage:
    /login
    /login <provider>

  Details:
    Configures API credentials from inside RadSim:
    
      • (no args)    — Pick a provider from a numbered menu
      • <provider>   — Run the API-key wizard for that provider
    
    After login, RadSim hot-swaps to the newly configured provider.

  Examples:
    $ /login
    $ /login openrouter
    $ /login claude

  Related: /logout  /config  /switch
